artworks.title: Porta San Lorenzo, Rome
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on blue wove paper, mounted on an album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient city wall with crenellations and a tower positioned on the left side. The horizon line is low, with no competing elements. The brushstrokes are subtle, suggesting a watercolor technique. The color palette consists of muted earthy tones and pale blue. A path or road leads the eye towards distant architectural structures, creating depth. The city wall extends towards additional towers in the distance under a pale blue sky.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.medium: red chalk with pen and brown ink and gray wash on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in various positions. A figure is centrally positioned, partially wrapped in cloth, being lowered from a cross. Other figures are assisting in this process. Surrounding them are several individuals, some on ladders reaching up to the cross, and others supporting from below. The figures wear different types of clothing, ranging from long, flowing garments to draped or historical attire. The individuals have indistinct facial features and varying hairstyles. The overall composition is dynamic, filled with movement and surrounded by abstract elements hinting at architecture or nature.

artworks.title: Cavalry Battle by a River
artworks.medium: gouache on vellum, laid down on an old mount
artworks.description: The image depicts a battle scene from an elevated point of view. It shows action close to us and the landscape in the distance. The horizon is in the upper third of the painting, showing land meeting the sky with distant blue hills or mountains. The sky has billowing clouds, and the brushstrokes focus on the movement of smoke and interactions of figures and horses. The color palette includes earthy tones of browns and greens, contrasting with deep blues and whites. In the foreground, two figures on horseback are prominently featured among soldiers and battle smoke. More figures are seen farther away. The ground is rugged with a body of water to the left.

artworks.title: Standing Woman
artworks.medium: red chalk, heightened with white chalk, on gray laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a full-length view of a person standing, positioned slightly turned to the side. The person appears to be a woman with delicate facial features. Her hair is styled in an updo, adorned with what seems to be a crown or a decorative hairpiece. She is dressed in a voluminous gown with wide sleeves and a defined waist that flares out into a full skirt. The hands are elegantly posed. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Kneeling Hermit and Two Draped Figures Contemplating a Skull
artworks.medium: pen with brown ink and touches of red chalk (at lower left) on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three robed figures. One holds a staff. Lines and shading are used to depict the figures. The central figure kneels with an extended arm. Rough forms suggest natural rock formations. Another figure in the background is holding a staff topped with a flame-like design. The drawing is made with fine line work and hatching, and it suggests historic or classical themes.

artworks.title: Standing Male Nude Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a full-length drawing of a male figure viewed from the side. The man's pose is a three-quarter turn, with his weight on one leg and the other leg slightly bent. His facial features are defined, with a prominent nose and a strong jawline, and his hair is short and neatly styled. The man's body appears mostly nude, with drapery covering his back. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mercury and Aglauros
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two full-length figures engaged in an interaction. The figure on the left is slightly turned facing the figure on the right. They wear a garment with draped fabric. The figure on the right is also shown in a slightly turned perspective, facing towards the left figure. They are dressed in a flowing robe-like garment. The background consists of softly rendered, crisscrossed shading.

artworks.title: Christ among the Doctors
artworks.medium: point of the brush and brown wash, heightened with white gouache over black chalk on paper washed gray-green, on two joined sheets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with multiple figures. The work presents a detailed and complex interior space dominated by towering arches and columns. In the foreground, figures gather and gesticulate. They are robed in flowing garments. The central figure is slightly elevated and seated beneath an alcove. The interplay of light and shadow creates a sense of depth and volume. The use of monochromatic tones accentuates the figures and the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Old Woman Working
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back turned, leaning forward over a table. They are wearing a long garment with folds, positioned their hands on the table's surface. The background is minimally detailed, hinting at an interior setting with a partial panel or partition visible on the left side.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Woman
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows the upper body of a person in a side profile position. The person's head and partial shoulder are visible, with their face turned slightly to the side. Their facial features are indistinct due to the art style, with a visible nose and chin. The hair is long and flows down behind the head, blending with the dark background. Clothing details are ambiguous, with shadows and textured dark markings dominating the image. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is a textured dark area that blends into the figure, creating a moody and abstract atmosphere.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man seated on the ground, holding a staff. He is mostly in profile, looking towards the upper right. He has muscular features, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, a long beard, and short curly hair. He wears a loose garment, leaving much of his upper body exposed. A lion is nearby on some rocks, and the man is surrounded by a rocky landscape. A straw hat and a tree branch are beside him. The background is intricately detailed with hatching and shading.

artworks.title: The Birth of Venus
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures engaged in an aquatic scene. The work features nude and semi-nude figures, including a central figure surrounded by cherub-like beings and other mythical creatures, such as dolphins and mermaids. The drawing uses soft, sweeping lines and shading to convey movement and fluidity, enhancing the dynamic composition. The creatures are animated in a swirling motion, and the interaction among the figures suggests a sense of playfulness and chaos. The use of a single color tone throughout the composition gives the piece a harmonious and unified appearance.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image shows a forest with a path winding through the trees, a figure carrying something on their shoulder walks on the path. The dense foliage covers the horizon. The landscape is detailed in fine etching strokes with various shades of gray creating a monochrome palette. Shadows and textures suggest depth, with a pond on the right.

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image depicts a woodland scene with tall, detailed trees dominating the foreground. The horizon is near the top of the image, with a path leading into the distance. A small patch of sky is visible between the branches. The etching technique shows intricate cross-hatching, adding texture and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on grey tones typical of an etching. In the distance, there are hints of a structure partially obscured by foliage.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with tall, gnarled trees, including one large tree dominating the center. Light is visible in the distance, creating depth through trees. The brushwork is detailed, with fine lines for texture. The color palette is mostly gray and black, typical of etching techniques. The play of light and shadow enhances the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dewayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated position, looking down a winding path. In the lower left corner, two dogs are near a fallen tree. The path leads through a dense forest with tall trees converging toward the center of the image. An old stone structure with arched openings is partially visible in the middle distance. The scene is framed by the trees reaching towards the sky. The horizon is obscured by trees and the sky is overcast. The artwork is in a monochrome palette of graphite grey, showing detailed textures of the trees, stone, and vegetation. Shadows and highlights create depth in the woodland setting.

artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a group of individuals seated in a semi-circle. They have varied appearances and are wearing flowing robes. One central figure, a woman, has her eyes closed and head covered. Some individuals are gesturing or looking upwards. Above some of them are flame-like symbols. In the upper part of the image, a dove emits rays of light, illuminating the scene. The background features radiating lines extending from the dove. A Latin inscription, "INDVIMINI: VIRTVTE, EXALTO," is at the bottom, accompanied by artistic signatures in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: The Tribute Money
artworks.medium: etching on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows five men standing closely together and engaged in conversation. Each man has unique features such as hair styles and facial hair. They are wearing different types of clothing, including robes and military attire. One man is gesturing with his hands. The background is plain with subtle texture.

artworks.title: The Death of Atilius Regulus
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with many figures engaged in various activities. The artwork shows a group of people around large barrels, with individuals either working on them or inspecting their contents. Some figures are on horses, while others interact directly. The scene is set in front of a stone wall, with clouds in the sky. The composition is detailed, conveying a sense of organized chaos in a busy gathering. The line work, expressions, and postures give the piece a dynamic quality, capturing a moment of collective human effort and interaction.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape with a Rocky Outcrop
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a ground-level view of a rugged, rocky landscape. There is a horizon line with faint outlines of distant landforms. The scene includes large, vertically rising rock formations with rough textures and cross-hatching marks. On the right side, a cluster of pine trees is visible. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. In the top left corner, leaves from a tree arch into the scene, providing a soft contrast to the sharp rocks.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Massé
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Louis Tocqué
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a seated man named Jean Baptiste Massé. He is facing slightly towards the viewer in a formal posture. He has a round face, wavy shoulder-length hair, and a subtle smile. He is dressed in an elaborate coat with large buttons and lace cuffs, along with a lace cravat. In his hand, he holds a large rolled sheet of paper with intricate designs. Beside him is an ornate table with art supplies and tools. The background includes a classical sculpture figure and a patterned wall or tapestry.

artworks.title: Ambassades envoyées des extrêmités de la Terre (Embassies Sent from the Extremities of the Globe) [pl. 15]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Pierre Soubeyran (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate decorative panel featuring allegorical figures and a central scene. The drawing portrays an ornately framed composition with two male figures standing on either side of an oval inset depicting a scene. Above the central scene is a bust-like face enclosed in a decorative frame surmounted by a basket of flowers and flanked by cherubs holding garlands. The entire piece carries a sense of opulence and grandeur, typical of Baroque architectural decorations and theme-based allegories.

artworks.title: La Prééminence de la France reconnue par l'Espagne 1662 (The Preeminance of France Recognized by Spain 1662) [pl. 17]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Bernard Lépicié (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring ornate classical figures and motifs. The image includes an elaborate architectural and decorative composition with an oval medallion at its center. Within the medallion, a scene depicts multiple classical figures in drapery surrounding a reclining lion. Outside the medallion, two bearded figures stand draped in fabric on each side. Above the medallion is a decorative crest with a human face, wings, floral garlands, and two cherubic figures. The architecture includes classical columns and ornate embellishments, with an inscription at the base reading "La Prééminence de la France reconnue par l'Espagne 1602."

artworks.title: Renouvellement d'Alliance avec les Suisses 1663 (Renewal of Alliance with the Swiss 1663) [pl. 18]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Nicolas-Gabriel Dupuis (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate decorative scene centered around an oval frame depicting a handshake. The drawing features a detailed and ornate design, with the central oval frame enclosed by intricate floral motifs and architectural elements. Surrounding the frame, there are two muscular figures positioned on each side. Above the figures, cherubic forms recline amidst a garland of flowers. The interior of the oval frame within the main structure displays a scene of two figures in classical attire shaking hands, with others observing. The overall style is reminiscent of baroque design, emphasizing grandeur and elaborate detail.
